_comment: Tracks upstream interfaces ConsoleForge depends on. The GHA drift-check workflow compares new Claude CLI releases against this file and opens an issue if review is needed.

terminal_protocols.kitty_keyboard: disabled — stripped in SwiftTermView.swift to prevent arrow key issues

swiftterm.pin_reason: EXACT, never `from:`. SwiftTerm owns the buffer model behind the permanent-garble class (tasks 9543 / 9487), so a version bump is a change to be VERIFIED with ./scripts/geometry-pass.py on beta, not a floor to float on. Two things since v1.16.0 are why: the cell width snaps to the NEAREST device pixel rather than rounding up (so TerminalMetrics is backing-scale dependent), and the per-cell write path gained semantic/bidi state.
swiftterm.supersedes: Was the bare revision 0f2af750 because PR #500 (kitty sequences misread as cursor restore) had no tagged release. It has shipped in every tag from v1.13.0 on, so the pin became a tag in v0.9.5 — this file was not updated then, and reported a stale commit for four days.

macos.signing: Developer ID Application + hardened runtime + notarization
